      "disposition": "already_represented"
    },
    {
      "quote": "Printing a name with multiple parts in uppercase letters causes the name to appear as one word unless the parts are separated with spaces.",
      "rationale": "Marked missing in the initial audit snapshot, but already represented by claim C0031.",
      "disposition": "already_represented"
    },
    {
      "quote": "b. Name spacing issues are generally not sufficient cause to rewrite a passport, unless the Department disregarded the applicant's clear preference (see 8 FAM 1001.2).",
      "rationale": "Marked missing in the initial audit snapshot, but already represented by claim C0032.",
      "disposition": "already_represented"
    },
    {
      "quote": "d. Some applicants may include the prefix “Sr.” as an abbreviation for “Señor” in Spanish meaning “Mr.” or “Mister” in English.",
      "rationale": "Marked missing in the initial audit snapshot, but already represented by claim C0033.",
      "disposition": "already_represented"
    },
    {
      "quote": "If you determine that this is the case, follow the guidance in 8 FAM 403.1-5(C) regarding ranks and titles.",
      "rationale": "Marked missing in the initial audit snapshot, but already represented by claim C0034.",
      "disposition": "already_represented"
    },
    {
      "quote": "e. Name suffix issues are generally not sufficient cause to rewrite a passport, unless the Department disregarded the applicant's clear preference (see 8 FAM 1001.2).",
      "rationale": "Marked missing in the initial audit snapshot, but already represented by claim C0035.",
      "disposition": "already_represented"
    },
    {
      "quote": "unless the Department disregarded the applicant's clear preference (see 8 FAM 1001.2)",
      "rationale": "This exception clause qualifies the baseline rewrite rules located in remote cross-reference 8 FAM 1001.2, which is not present in the draft packet.",
      "disposition": "unresolved"
    }
  ]
}
